entities.name: Nicolaus Copernicus
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Polish astronomer (1473-1543) who formulated the heliocentric model of the solar system, placing the Sun rather than Earth at the center. His De Revolutionibus Orbium Coelestium (1543) launched the Scientific Revolution by challenging the Ptolemaic geocentric model that had dominated astronomy for 1,400 years.
